meaning: Geometry provision coverage only. No row establishes physical compliance or a passed engineering release gate.

requirements.evidence: parameters.json and assembly_manifest.json: belt 600 mm, carrying 3000 mm, deck 1000 mm; overall envelope remains separate.
Tapered hopper, sloped spreader, isolated stand and settling belt; feed performance untested.
Closed 6 mm belt loop and four rollers; composition, splice, sharp-fragment resistance, tension and pulley suitability unselected.

Nonmetallic window and removable cassette, no steel support in reserved active gap;8 mm enclosure/window gap geometrically checked. Coil active standoff, full field exclusion and height adjustment design remain held.
Slotted camera mount/crossrail, lens envelope;400×300 mm footprint is uncalibrated and does not claim 600 mm coverage.
Angled diffuse light bars and hood with removable windows; illuminance/glare/thermal/cleaning performance untested.
Three depth device parts explicitly optional=true,installed=false,default_hidden=true; no selected laser or performance.
Head-shaft encoder/bracket; does not measure belt-to-roller or item slip. Measuring-wheel selection remains a hold.
Last active sensing plane 1750 and lip 3000 explicit;1250 mm ideal travel. Registration and timing validation unperformed.
12 generic nozzle/union envelopes at 50 mm pitch; slotted mounting plates and discrete generic valves; impulse, latency, tubing/circuit and mounted ranges unvalidated.

Full-width static intake spans and convergent guides, upstream-facing balance/review gate and defined branch boundaries; current full_width_routing_review.json checks source-solid routing. Nominal contacts are not physical seals. A 1.5 m/s gravity-only outer-lane point-path counterexample overflies the funnel wall by about 70 mm; existing side guards do not collect it. No operating speed or full-width no-jet capture is approved. Accepted-feed thickness/height, leakage, friction, bridging, bounce and physical flow remain design holds.
Rounded RHS, hollow rollers, bearing envelopes, slotted tail tensioner/locks, finned drive enclosure; no load/tension/torque calculations or purchased part selection.
Tail cheeks, return trough/access panels, hood and ejection observation panels; full guarding/access-interlock/safety function architecture incomplete.
Removable panels and cassette, forward bin withdrawal with all actual parts conservatively swept; cleaning performance/operator handling untested.
Cabinet, cable trunk, conduit, optical duct and glands; site supply/wiring/shielding/bonding and thermal rating unselected.
Source/export provenance and coordinated dimension/section/BOM package; no fabrication or compliance release.
